section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical analyses used to evaluate the BAS-2, including CFAs run separately for boys and girls in three countries (Denmark, Portugal, Sweden), multi-group CFAs to test measurement invariance across sex and country, internal consistency reliability analyses, and convergent validity correlations (including BMI). The provided table lists means, standard deviations, and Cronbach's alphas across country and sex and reports sample sizes (N=1012; country-by-sex subgroup ns).
